name: vardoger
description: Personalizes your AI assistant from local conversation history using the active host model.

interface.longDescription: Vardoger reads your Codex conversation history locally, extracts behavioral patterns, and generates a personalized AGENTS.md addition so the assistant adapts to how you actually work. Local history handling stays on your machine; model-side analysis follows your host assistant's data policy.
defaultPrompt: Analyze my Codex history and personalize how you work with me.
Show what you have learned about my working preferences.
Refresh my Vardoger personalization from recent conversations.
